summary: Pendopo Airport (PDO) is a medium-sized regional airport serving the Talang Gudang area in South Sumatra Province, Indonesia. It primarily supports connectivity to the surrounding oil and gas producing regions of southern Sumatra. The airport plays a key role in linking remote communities and energy sector operations to larger hubs in the region.
faqs:
Q: What is the airport code for Pendopo Airport?
A: The IATA code is PDO and the ICAO code is WIPQ.

Q: Where is Pendopo Airport located?
A: It is situated in Talang Gudang on Sumatra Island, in the South Sumatra Province of Indonesia.

Q: What type of airport is Pendopo?
A: It is classified as a medium-sized regional airport serving domestic routes within Sumatra.

Q: How large is Pendopo Airport?
A: The airport has a size score of 550, indicating a medium-sized facility compared to other airports globally.
transport_tips: Ground transportation options at Pendopo Airport are limited, so arranging a private car or hotel transfer in advance is strongly recommended. Local taxis and ojek (motorcycle taxis) may be available outside the terminal depending on flight schedules. Travel times to nearby towns can vary significantly depending on road conditions in the South Sumatra region.
local_tip: Carry cash in Indonesian rupiah (IDR) as smaller terminals in Sumatra often have limited or no card payment facilities for transport and snacks.
